title: Government Notifies 100% FDI in Insurance Companies Under Automatic Route
summary: Ministry of Finance notifies FEMA Non-debt Instruments 2nd Amendment Rules 2026, allowing 100% FDI in insurance sector (LIC capped at 20%).

blocks.content: Ministry of Finance notified amendments to Foreign Exchange Management (Non-debt Instruments) Rules 2019, permitting **100% FDI under automatic route** in insurance companies and intermediaries (brokers), while LIC remains capped at 20%.

provenance.sourceTitle: Government Notifies 100% FDI in Insurance Companies Under Automatic Route
